points.point: 市場需求端：5G FWA operator 的 Rel.16 需求包含 mmWave 載波聚合由 4CC/8CC 擴到 10CC，以及吞吐由 7.9 Gbps 提升到 10 Gbps、FR1+FR2 ENDC 轉為 DC/CA
points.label: missing
points.why: No 5G FWA Rel.16, 10CC, 10 Gbps, or ENDC to DC/CA chain

points.point: 市場需求被轉成 RF parametric 可量測參數：Output power、EVM、OBW、receiver sensitivity level BLER、band permutations and CAs（多為 operator 要求）
points.label: partial
points.why: Mentions output power/spectrum, but not EVM, OBW, BLER, band permutations/CAs

points.point: 這些測試需求對應到的儀器類別明確包含 VSA（signal analyzer）與 VSG（signal generator），具體型號為 R&S FSW 與 R&S SMW200A
points.label: covered
points.why: Identifies signal generator/analyzer classes and SMW200A/FSW models

points.point: 基地台側的可量測參數清單來自 3GPP TS 38.141-1 chapter 6，含 Modulation quality、Occupied bandwidth、ACLR 等 transmitted signal quality 與 unwanted emissions 項目
points.label: missing
points.why: No TS 38.141-1 chapter 6, modulation quality, OBW, ACLR, emissions mapping

points.point: 參數 → signal analyzer 能力：ACLR（6.6.3）需要 FSW base unit 加 FSW-K144 5G NR option，並在 5G NR mode 以 Channel Power ACLR / EVM 量測功能執行；OBW 則用 spectrum analyzer mode 基本功能
points.label: missing
points.why: No FSW-K144, 5G NR mode, Channel Power ACLR/EVM, or OBW spectrum mode details

points.point: 參數 → signal generator 能力：receiver 類參數（Dynamic range、ACS、blocking、intermodulation）需要 SMW200A 配 2× baseband generator、baseband main module B13T/B13XT、兩條 RF path、AWGN option K62 與 2× K144
points.label: missing
points.why: No receiver tests or required SMW200A 2× baseband, B13T/B13XT, RF paths, K62, 2×K144

points.point: 頻寬需求（FR2 test model 100/200/400 MHz 與寬頻 CA）決定硬體能力門檻：signal generator 需 wideband baseband（SMW-B13XT）提供 up to 2 GHz RF modulation bandwidth
points.label: partial
points.why: States SMW200A up to 2 GHz RF modulation bandwidth, but not FR2 100/200/400 MHz, CA, or SMW-B13XT

points.point: 對應地 signal analyzer 需加購 analysis bandwidth 硬體選項（例如 FSW-B2001 提供 2 GHz analysis bandwidth）才能涵蓋寬頻訊號分析
points.label: partial
points.why: Mentions FSW analysis bandwidth, but not required hardware options such as FSW-B2001 2 GHz
